title: Red Lorry Yellow Lorry
subtitle: R vs L Contrast
description: This exercise sharpens the contrast between the /r/ and /l/ sounds, which are commonly confused by many learners. Alternating the two sounds at speed forces precise tongue placement for each.
tip: For /l/, touch your tongue tip to the ridge just behind your upper teeth. For /r/, curl the tip back without touching anything — practice each sound in isolation before combining them.
phrases: Red lorry, yellow lorry, red lorry, yellow lorry.
Larry's large lorry lurched around the rural road.
The rural librarian rarely relies on elaborate rules.
Rolling red barrels around really rural roads requires real effort.
